chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Manchester City against Real Madrid, Champions League semi-final. City pass on the right. De Bruyne slides it through, Bernardo Silva is in... near post, goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Bernardo sneaks into the space behind the defenders, and lifts it inside the near post.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Here's how he keeps the ball, even from big defenders. Tiny touches with his left foot, his body in the way. One defender, two... and he wriggles free!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: keep the ball glued to your foot, and use your body to shield it.
